securityAndLifecycle: Package raw bytes are SHA256-pinned; schema binds exact candidate creation/runtime hashes, source/profile/storage/immutable offsets and EBA/a5e/bd3 activation baseline.
Candidate and installed proxy both require MAX_OPEN_PACKS10 and uint256 PERMIT_OPEN_VERSION1; exact address-patched UUPS runtime and ERC1967 slot are verified.

Each deploy/upgrade has a fresh fee/gas simulation and explicit separate review. Owner/account/chain are rechecked after asynchronous simulation and immediately before send; leaving the route blocks late sends.

Receipts bind requested hash and matching mined block, owner, creation/upgrade calldata, value and actual deployed address. Matching repriced hashes are persisted; unrelated replacement data is refused.
Pending or ambiguous saved hashes block fresh submissions; only explicit canonical reverted/cancelled receipt resolution clears them. Confirmed addresses are reverified after refresh.
Returning to the original account/network cannot resurrect a cancelled captured review; the final send requires the exact still-active review object.
runtimeLimitations: All wallet/RPC responses in browser acceptance are synthetic; external requests are intercepted or blocked. No actual owner signature, transaction or onchain upgrade was performed.
This preparation does not publish the frontend. Root owns deployment and the real owner controls any later two-step upgrade.

resolvedIndependentFinding.fix: Synchronous active-review ref invalidation on observed wallet/account/chain changes and dismiss/unmount. Exact captured-review identity, expiry and latest wallet are asserted after the final await immediately before send with no await gap.
